integrationDetails: WindowRegistry.caller(event) establishes current native identity but returns a fresh projection. Use capture(event), which calls caller and privately records the actual sender/frame, when later passing a grant to isCurrent/captureAdmissionGuard. Never clone/reconstruct it.

Grant projection has no mode/access fields. Main supplies live getMode/canExecute checks from actual selected project, write permission, PIN and quiescence; do not infer permission from role or cached grant fields.

captureAdmissionGuard is monotonic across freeze/rollback. Pending selection/profile operations retain originating scope; future project-bound cwd reuse is separately authorized by a current eligible same-project caller.
Current main can relocate Data. Future protected roots must come from active Data and actual install/runtime/resources/generated roots, not hardcoded portable/Data or renderer/project content.

ownedDirectory is read-only with create:false but is not a complete cwd grant: no remembered filesystem identity or atomic binding to subsequent process creation. Never call create:true or writableDataRoot for selected cwd.
PIN worker strips Electron/Node/VSCode prefixed variables; this is precedent, not authorization to silently copy its complete worker spawn policy into an interactive shell.
decisionsAndLimits: Injected inspection/discovery/current/admission/id providers are main-only implementation seams, not new renderer API. Existing preflight lifecycle/capacity suggestions remain recommendations; choose finite documented bounds and matching refusal receipts explicitly.

Declare supported path namespaces and link/reparse policy; local drive paths/roots can be first supported slice. Do not silently accept unqualified UNC/device/extended paths. Windows double quote is a refusal fixture, not shell escaping.
Directory identity/reparse detection and trusted executable discovery require a real Windows adapter and later actual witnesses. Pure fake providers test decision logic only.
Repeated path revalidation does not eliminate TOCTOU before spawn. Do not claim directory sandbox or atomic handle binding; shell retains OS-user privileges.

Task1 atomic host/session Job membership, host startup interval, native monitor/cleanup, actual compiler/SDK/Electron ABI and helper/package/license qualification block native create/host/PTY admission, not these pure authorities.

No terminal role, dock/satellite, preload, main IPC, generic spawn, PTY, emulator, dependencies, package or UI should be added by this pure tranche. Typed IPC tests are boundary-model tests, not real Electron IPC evidence.
